title: Fill the circles

steps.title: Find a small area
steps.body: Choose a few outlined circles. The spaces between them are part of the image.

steps.title: Fill each circle
steps.body: Use the trial marker to fill inside each circular boundary. Keep separate circles separate.

steps.title: Follow the changing sizes
steps.body: Fill the shape that is printed, including the smaller circles. Do not turn every mark into the same size.

steps.title: Compare and record
steps.body: Compare the filled area with the digital reference. Record guide visibility, control and any marks that join.
